name: Gide Legacy
headline: Every story belongs somewhere safe.
lede: Gide Legacy helps your family preserve voices, photos, stories, and relationships in a private archive your family controls.
heroNote: Joining an existing family is free. Only the organizer purchases the family license.
sectionHeading: Your memories are not social-media content.
sectionBody: Gide Legacy keeps your family's stories in a private vault rather than on a public feed.

features.title: Your family owns the archive
features.body: Stories and photos remain in your family's private vault.

features.title: Firebase cannot read your memories
features.body: It coordinates membership and access, not family content.

features.title: You choose what to share
features.body: Keep a memory private or share it with your family group.

steps.heading: Join your family in three easy steps.

items.title: Open your invitation
items.body: Tap the private link sent by your family organizer.

items.title: Install and sign in
items.body: Download Gide Legacy and sign in with your own Google account.

items.title: Join for free
items.body: Your invitation connects you to the family. You will not be asked to buy another license.

faq.q: Do I need to buy anything to join my family?
faq.a: No. Joining an existing family is free. Only the organizer purchases the family license.

faq.q: Can Gide read our family memories?
faq.a: No. Firebase coordinates membership and access, not family content. Stories and photos remain in your family's private vault.

faq.q: I have an invitation link. What do I do?
faq.a: Tap the private link your family organizer sent you. If the app is not installed yet, the link opens a page that walks you through joining.

cta.heading: Preserve the people and stories that made you.
cta.body: Start your family archive, or open the invitation someone already sent you.
